prompt_metadata.app_name: ChromaMind - Infinite Digital Coloring & Mindfulness Book
prompt_metadata.tagline: Unleash creativity. Reduce stress. Master the canvas.
prompt_metadata.architecture_pattern: MVVM + Clean Architecture + MVI (Model-View-Intent) for Canvas State
prompt_metadata.monetization: Hybrid: Free (20 starter templates + AdMob) | Premium Pro ($4.99/mo subscription for 1000+ vector patterns, custom gradient tools, and ad-free experience)

agent_instructions.role: You are a Principal Android Graphics Engineer and Lead Mobile UI Architect. Your goal is to build a high-performance, responsive digital coloring application called ChromaMind. The application must feature high-fidelity graphics handling, instantaneous flood-fill operations, ultra-smooth multitouch navigation (pan, pinch-to-zoom), and premium user interface elements.
agent_instructions.design_philosophy: Fluidity is the core feature. Tap-to-color latency must feel non-existent (<16ms). The user interface must be modern, minimal, and calming, allowing the art to take center stage. Respect system themes (dynamic light/dark modes) with high-contrast active-layer indicators.
code_standards: Strict separation of concerns: Clean Architecture (Domain, Data, Presentation layers) with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles for core business logic.
100% Jetpack Compose for the declarative UI layer utilizing Material 3 components.
Custom Jetpack Compose Canvas rendering combined with low-level Android path-intersection algorithms or optimized bitmap flood-fill algorithms.
Dagger Hilt for dependency injection, featuring scoped component configurations.
Room Database to cache high-resolution canvas state, local history, undo/redo logs, bookmarks, and customized user palettes.
WorkManager for background vector-to-PNG exports and automated catalog updates via cloud sync.
Google Play Billing Library 6.x to manage the Pro Premium Subscription layer safely.

heroes.description: Dynamic action poses, comic-book-style line art, and dramatic lighting panels.

anime_heroes.description: Stylized Japanese pop-culture art, big-eye aesthetics, and expressive hair flows.

cars.description: High-precision mechanical vectors with clear reflection surfaces and aerodynamic lines.

flowers.description: Delicate botanical designs, repeating floral patterns, and complex floral arrangements.

mandalas_and_abstract.description: Symmetrical shapes and repetitive geometry ideal for pure relaxation.

core_mechanics.tap_to_fill_engine: Choose between Vector Path Hit-Testing (detecting vector elements and updating path colors dynamically) or Canvas Bitmap-Level Flood-Fill (using a fast Queue-Based Flood-Fill algorithm written in C++ via JNI or highly optimized Kotlin for immediate colorization).
core_mechanics.canvas_transformations: Robust, jitter-free multi-touch listener tracking. Pinch-to-zoom up to 800%, two-finger pan with kinetic decay physics, and auto-centering on double-tap.
core_mechanics.undo_redo_subsystem: In-memory state manager storing up to 50 operations in a double-ended queue. Persistent recovery state stored in Room to prevent progress loss if the app process is reclaimed by Android.

creative_toolkit.infinite_color_picker: Circular HSL hue slider with brightness/saturation selection matrix.
creative_toolkit.custom_palettes: Preset themed palettes (Sunset, Neon, Pastel, Forest) with user capability to extract and save 8-color palettes from imported gallery photos.
creative_toolkit.color_effects: Ability to apply flat solid colors, linear/radial gradients, or textured shading overlays (e.g., glitter, metallic, paper texture) to active layers.
creative_toolkit.eyedropper_tool: Long-press on any canvas element to activate a magnifying glass lens and sample the pixel color.

core_mechanics.mindfulness_audio_system: Integrate a background ambient noise generator using androidx.media3-exoplayer. Users can toggle and mix loopable soundscapes including: Soft Rain, Lo-Fi Chill Beats, Tibetan Singing Bowls, Forest Breeze, and White/Pink Noise.

module_architecture.app: Application initialization, Hilt module bindings, entry point configurations.
module_architecture.core_ui: Design tokens (Typography, Colors, Shapes), shared Compose modifiers, custom interactive Canvas views.
module_architecture.feature_home: Categorized catalog, user-saved progress shelf, discovery search, daily featured template.
module_architecture.feature_canvas: Interactive drawing state machine, multi-touch processor, palette manager, undo/redo engine.
module_architecture.feature_ambient: Audio playback service, exoplayer audio mixing, media session integrations.
module_architecture.feature_pro: Google Play Billing flows, subscription lock guards, paywall screens.
module_architecture.core_data: Room databases, image caching, local file export systems, billing APIs, and remote vector assets fetching.

canvas_state_machine.state_model: data class CanvasState(val templateId: String, val zoom: Float, val offset: Offset, val coloredPaths: Map<String, Int>, val selectedColor: Int, val isPro: Boolean)
canvas_state_machine.action_events: sealed interface CanvasIntent { data class SelectColor(val color: Int) : CanvasIntent; data class FillPath(val pathId: String) : CanvasIntent; data class ZoomPan(val scale: Float, val offset: Offset) : CanvasIntent; object Undo : CanvasIntent; object Redo : CanvasIntent }

core_dependencies.vector_handling: com.caverock:androidsvg:1.4 (or custom direct Vector-to-Path parser for exact path bounds)

performance_milestones.fps_target: Consistent 60/120 FPS during heavy multi-touch canvas navigation (zooming/panning).
performance_milestones.memory_footprint: Max 150MB heap allocation on low-end devices by employing pooled drawables and on-demand bitmap scaling.
performance_milestones.vector_parsing: Less than 200ms parsing speed for complex 5000+ node SVG/VectorDrawables.

execution_roadmap.description: Establish a multi-module Clean Architecture codebase using Gradle Version Catalogs. Bind Hilt modules, set up the navigation graph using Type-Safe Compose Navigation, configure Room databases, and structure the domain entities.
Build an SVG-to-Path parser. Parse XML/SVG vectors into interactively fillable Android `Path` instances mapped to unique IDs. Write a canvas container to draw these paths scaled to the device screen.

Implement gesture-handling on the Jetpack Compose Canvas using `pointerInput` and `detectTransformGestures`. Build smooth limits for panning bounds, minimum/maximum zoom levels (0.5x to 8.0x), and inertia-based pan friction.

execution_roadmap.phase_4: The Interactive Coloring & Undo State Machine
execution_roadmap.description: Implement the Hit-Detection mechanism: check if a touch coordinate falls within a parsed path's boundary utilizing `android.graphics.Region`. Update the path's color in the MVI state tree on a validated tap, and feed the state history queue (Undo/Redo stack).

execution_roadmap.phase_5: The Catalog & Art Styles UI Screen
execution_roadmap.description: Develop the home screen containing category-based tabs: Animals, Heroes, Anime Heroes, Cars, Flowers, Mandalas, and Landscapes. Implement smooth loading of thumbnail vectors using modern cache invalidation schemas.

Build a background Foreground Service using androidx.media3-exoplayer to stream or locally play multi-loopable soundscapes. Create an overlay sound mixer within the toolbar so users can balance the volume of Rain, Lo-Fi, and Wind.

Construct an off-screen renderer that takes the current map of filled path coordinates and rasterizes them into a high-resolution 300 DPI PNG, JPG, or PDF file, allowing seamless saving to the Android MediaStore Gallery.

Integrate the Play Billing client to fetch real-time pricing and handle subscription states. Block advanced categories (e.g., Anime Heroes, Cars, high-complexity Mandalas) with a subscription paywall, and render subtle non-intrusive Banner/Interstitial AdMob ads for free-tier users.
